t: Fix: Display → Test update screen now really shows the update picture for 6 s
Display → Test update screen (6 s): shows the update picture on the display with a running bar, without updating
Display during an online update: smooth, anti-aliased font (DejaVu Sans Bold) instead of the jagged pixel font
Web page checked page by page: all cards same width and centered, all values in one column (no two-column lists any more)
Transmitter: channel fields of all switches and buttons at the same position, dropdowns aligned
Outputs → High beam: sliders and values of the levels line up with the other rows
Menu bar wraps into a second row on a wide screen instead of hiding tabs
Drift & Auto: msp_override_channels shows steering + throttle channel (no false red warning)
Maps & rides → Load maps → Coordinates or map link: button Open Google Maps (opens at the entered coordinates, otherwise at the car) – find a place, copy the link and paste it into the field
Files on the SD card: free space shown in GB (e.g. 29.6 GB free of 29.7 GB)
Display during an online update: design C – card like the start screen with MOJAVE CORE, blue UPDATE, old → new version and progress bar
Transmitter: channel field of each switch and button sits right above the end of its dropdowns
FC and Transmitter tabs: all cards the same width and centered, content fills the card
Transmitter: Switches and Button assignment in one column (Switch 2 under Switch 1, Button 2 under Button 1)
Display during an online update: new design – MOJAVE, glowing UPDATE, version pill, blue gradient progress bar
Faster back after an update: the Core connects straight to the last Wi-Fi access point (no search) and the web page checks every 0.5 s
System → Wi-Fi line shows how many seconds after start the Wi-Fi was connected
Online update: while loading, the card with the new version and what is new stays visible (blue); the old Updated box is hidden meanwhile
Channel bars half as long again, and the same length on all pages (Transmitter → Channel overview and FC → Channels live)
High beam flash removed completely (button action, Flash now and its settings). Buttons that had flash now do nothing
High beam when disarmed: always the set % (Outputs → High beam → When disarmed, 0 % = off). High beam button 1× short switches it off / back on. When you arm, the last driving level comes back
Transmitter → Channel overview: value stands right next to the bar
Outputs → High beam: new Max. when disarmed (%) – while disarmed the high beam (and the flash) is at most this bright, 0 % = off. Armed: normal levels
